title: SYNTHETIC: Mouse efficacy study of candidate X-001

sections.heading: Animal model
sections.text: In the synthetic Disease-D mouse model, the SYN-1 inhibitor candidate X-001 lowered marker M by 48% after 4 weeks of dosing. The mouse model reproduces only the inflammatory component of Disease-D.

sections.heading: Species differences
sections.text: The human SYN-1 ortholog shares 71% sequence identity with the mouse protein. Binding affinity of X-001 for the human protein was not measured.

evidence.excerpt: In the synthetic Disease-D mouse model, the SYN-1 inhibitor candidate X-001 lowered marker M by 48% after 4 weeks of dosing.
limitations: Mouse data only; not evidence of human efficacy.
